description: This file defines an Android activity class 'OnboardingActivity' responsible for showing an onboarding screen with a button to start the main game. It includes methods for lifecycle management and dynamic resource resolution.

classes.name: OnboardingActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that handles onboarding UI, initializes layout, and navigates to the main activity on button click.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Android Activity onCreate lifecycle method to set up the onboarding screen and button click listener.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Helper method to resolve layout resource IDs dynamically by name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Helper method to resolve view ID resources dynamically by name.
